title: Clean Hands
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens Clean Hands and the helm marks Feedstock. Do: Close on Feedstock. The Fine Clerk orbits sterile ice. A dirty hold is a fine. The warden patrol hails before the guns. Finish: come inside Feedstock's shell. The Choir writes standing. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
